knowledge.plain_language_summary: A double-faced monument: a 12in fabricated aluminum structure on a 6in steel pipe in a poured footing, with face-lit routed primary letterforms (acrylic-backed), face-lit channel-letter wordmark, a halo-illuminated dimensional element, and a non-illuminated saddle-mounted accent.
knowledge.rationale: Layering face-lit, halo, and non-lit elements on an engineered steel-pipe structure makes a premium tenant monument.

structure.construction: 12in fabricated aluminum, 0.090in skin, internal angle frame + stiffeners, 6in Sch40 steel pipe in 36x48in poured footing
19in letterforms routed out of face, backed translucent white acrylic, internal white LED (face-lit)
3in deep 0.063in face-lit channel letters, silver returns, Jewelite trim cap, white LED
painted satin black, halo white LED, routed letterforms backed translucent white acrylic; duranodic bronze 1st-surface vinyl

utilities.power: Principal Qwik-Mod 3 LEDs, Class II supplies, 120V/20A dedicated circuit

craft_observations: Face-lit + halo + non-lit elements layered on an engineered steel-pipe structure.
